text:
Rohit: Heads-up 10% median delta between invoice_preview and final for a handful of preview tenants this morning. Sample tenant: helios.studio.

Mae: Any obvious pattern? preview uses aggregated partials by (sampling_id, model_alias) right? final replays raw events and dedupes by req_id.

Rohit: Right. Quick triage shows preview merged two partials for the same req_id because model_alias changed mid-flight after router fallback. Example: req_id=r-3290: partial A sampling_id=smp-7 model_alias_raw=gpt4a-std tokens=300; partial B sampling_id=null model_alias_canon=gpt4a-std-quant tokens=150 -> preview sums both -> 450. Final dedupe by req_id gives 300.

Ola: So the router is rewriting attributes on fallback and dropping sampling_id in that code path. Any deploys recently?

deploy-bot: router-fallback-service v5.0.2 deployed 2026-05-10T02:05Z. Change: normalize model_alias and remove vendor postfix in fallback path.

Mae: That matches. Normalization path isn't preserving sampling_id. Also preview reads pre-normalizer stream for latency. Final uses normalized stream for billing. Two differences: alias canonicalization and sampling_id presence.

Rohit: Short-term mitigation ideas: 1) make preview merge prefer req_id dedupe when req_id present, 2) patch router to preserve sampling_id during normalization, 3) add sku_map alias synonyms so token_factor aligns.

Ola: 1) is the quickest and safest for preview accuracy without changing upstreams. We can change preview merge logic to dedupe by req_id first if present, falling back to sampling_id.

Mae: Agreed. Also add a temporary alias mapping for a set of quantized SKUs used in canary. That avoids tokenization factor drift while we fix router.

Rohit: I'll run a query to list affected tenants and windows. Query: 
SELECT tenant_id, req_id, SUM(tokens) as preview_tokens
FROM preview.aggregates
WHERE window_start >= '2026-05-10T00:00:00Z' AND window_end <= '2026-05-10T06:00:00Z'
  AND sampling_id IS NULL
GROUP BY tenant_id, req_id
HAVING SUM(tokens) > 0
LIMIT 200;

Rohit: Got ~28 tenants; attached CSV to BILL-3599.

billing-bot: BILL-3599 created: "preview vs final token delta - fallback normalization" assigned to @Mae. Link: https://billing.redwood/tickets/BILL-3599

Ola: Plan: Mae will patch preview merge to prefer req_id dedupe and deploy to canary within 2h. Rohit will schedule a scoped recompute of preview aggregates for CSV windows once merge change is live. I will open PR to router to preserve sampling_id in normalization path and add unit test.

Mae: Also adding dashboard panel: preview_vs_final_token_delta_pct by tenant, alert when delta > 5% for 20m. QA: please include an e2e test that sends a synthetic request with sampling_id and forces fallback to ensure sampling id persists.

qa-bot: Added test task QA-2891 to canary e2e suite.

Rohit: Postmortem items: (A) contract test for router -> aggregator (sampling_id must be present or explicit null_reason), (B) dedupe precedence doc (req_id > sampling_id > alias), (C) console UI change: show "alias used by preview" vs "alias used by final" on invoice preview page, (D) add alias synonym entries in sku_map as short-term.

Mae: I'll open PR for preview change and include migration note. Rohit, attach the event CSV to BILL-3599 and I'll kick off recompute after canary verification.

Ola: Thanks. Will follow up with PR link and ETA."
